description: EcoMind provides a web application for classifying and labelling images of reusable solid waste. SASVAR project contributors publish it to help build task-specific datasets, using characteristics such as material, packaging colour and capacity. The repository links user and developer manuals and describes installation through a Python server or Docker. Geographic coverage and collection dates depend on the user-provided images; the software has no fixed image dataset or spatial and temporal resolution. GitHub supplies the source under MIT, permitting free reuse. The SoftwareX article identifies Python, HTML, CSS and JavaScript and describes collaborative dataset creation. A limitation is that this is a labelling tool, not a waste-collection or treatment simulator; label quality and the representativeness of the images remain user responsibilities. It can prepare observations for waste-classification models and checks on material-flow assumptions. Related catalogue records were not linked because no specific model interface was verified. No images were uploaded or downloaded, and neither the application nor a classifier was executed.
